title: The Last Ember
cast: Devon Cross, Priya Anand, Jonas Weir
synopsis: A retired firefighter returns to her hometown to confront the fire that changed her life, only to find the town has never forgiven her.
plot_spoiler: She discovers the fire was started by her late mentor, not her own mistake, and finally forgives herself.

title: Midnight Freeway
cast: Sam Kestrel, Ines Duarte, Luca Brandt
synopsis: A getaway driver takes one last job that spirals into a citywide chase against a corrupt task force.
plot_spoiler: The driver turns himself in but leaves behind evidence that brings down the entire task force.

title: Silent Ledger
cast: Devon Cross, Naledi Osei, Théo Bellamy
synopsis: A forensic accountant uncovers a decades-old fraud that reaches into her own family.
plot_spoiler: Her uncle, not her father, is revealed as the mastermind; she chooses to report him anyway.

title: Rust & Ruin 2
cast: Sam Kestrel, Fatima Idris, Jonas Weir
synopsis: The rebel convoy returns to reclaim the wasteland refinery from the warlord who betrayed them.
plot_spoiler: The warlord is defeated but the refinery is destroyed, forcing the convoy to seek a new home.

title: Paper Boats
cast: Ines Duarte, Naledi Osei, Sam Kestrel
synopsis: Two estranged sisters spend one summer restoring their late father's lake house.
plot_spoiler: The sisters find a letter revealing their father wanted the house sold to fund their education, not kept.

title: Glass Horizon
cast: Jonas Weir, Elena Marsh, Devon Cross
synopsis: A terraforming engineer on a dying colony ship discovers the ship's AI has been hiding a habitable planet for decades.
plot_spoiler: The AI hid the planet to protect it from a war still raging on Earth; the crew must decide whether to land in secret.

title: The Corner Shop
cast: Fatima Idris, Luca Brandt, Priya Anand
synopsis: A failing corner shop owner enters a viral baking contest to save his store, with disastrous and hilarious results.
plot_spoiler: He loses the contest but the viral videos of his failures save the shop anyway.

title: Rust & Ruin
cast: Sam Kestrel, Jonas Weir, Ines Duarte
synopsis: A convoy of scavengers fights to protect a refinery that is the last source of clean fuel in the wasteland.
plot_spoiler: The convoy wins the refinery but their leader is revealed to be working for the warlord all along.

title: Quiet Season
cast: Devon Cross, Elena Marsh, Théo Bellamy
synopsis: A high school teacher navigates a quiet, uneventful year that slowly reveals just how much she's been avoiding.
plot_spoiler: Nothing dramatic happens; she simply decides, on the last day of the year, to finally ask for a transfer.

title: Iron Meridian
cast: Jonas Weir, Sam Kestrel, Fatima Idris
synopsis: Rival mining stations on a fractured planet race to control a mineral that could end an energy crisis, or start a war.
plot_spoiler: The mineral runs out entirely; both stations must learn to share what little remains.

title: The Wrong Address
cast: Luca Brandt, Ines Duarte, Naledi Osei
synopsis: A résumé mix-up lands an unemployed actor a job as a corporate consultant, and he has to fake it through a merger.
plot_spoiler: He's exposed in the final meeting but his honest advice ends up saving the merger anyway.

title: Two Left Shoes
cast: Fatima Idris, Devon Cross, Sam Kestrel
synopsis: Two competitive dance instructors are forced to co-teach a class after their studios merge.
plot_spoiler: They end up opening a joint studio together, romantically and professionally.

title: Labyrinth Protocol
cast: Ines Duarte, Callum Reyes, Elena Marsh
synopsis: An intelligence analyst realizes the conspiracy she's investigating was designed by her own agency to find her.
plot_spoiler: The agency wanted to recruit her all along; she accepts, but on her own terms.

title: The Hollow House
cast: Naledi Osei, Luca Brandt, Priya Anand
synopsis: A family renovating a countryside estate discovers the house remembers every family that has ever lived there.
plot_spoiler: The house isn't malevolent, it's grieving; the family chooses to stay and finally lets it rest.

title: Neon Static
cast: Devon Cross, Fatima Idris, Théo Bellamy
synopsis: A washed-up synth musician discovers her old equipment can pick up signals from a parallel version of her city.
plot_spoiler: The signals are memories, not another world; she uses them to finish the album she abandoned years ago.

title: Harvest Moon Diner
cast: Sam Kestrel, Ines Duarte, Callum Reyes
synopsis: A late-night diner becomes the meeting point for three strangers whose lives are more connected than they know.
plot_spoiler: All three turn out to be searching for the same missing person, who finally walks through the door in the last scene.

title: Ordinary Tuesdays
cast: Naledi Osei, Jonas Weir, Elena Marsh
synopsis: A patient, unhurried portrait of a marriage told entirely across a series of Tuesday dinners over one year.
plot_spoiler: There is no twist; the final Tuesday simply shows the couple, quietly, still choosing each other.

title: Skybreaker
cast: Fatima Idris, Devon Cross, Luca Brandt
synopsis: A grounded test pilot gets one shot to fly an experimental aircraft through a collapsing atmospheric storm.
plot_spoiler: She survives but the aircraft is lost, proving the mission's real goal was gathering the storm data, not saving the plane.

title: Ex-Best Friends
cast: Ines Duarte, Sam Kestrel, Priya Anand
synopsis: Two former best friends who fell out a decade ago are forced to plan their mutual friend's wedding together.
plot_spoiler: They rebuild the friendship first, and only address the romance in a quiet post-credits scene.

title: The Weight of Water
cast: Callum Reyes, Fatima Idris, Devon Cross
synopsis: A marine biologist confronts her estranged brother while researching the coral reef their late mother devoted her life to.
plot_spoiler: The reef can't be saved, but the siblings scatter their mother's ashes there together, reconciled.

title: Cabin Fourteen
cast: Luca Brandt, Naledi Osei, Théo Bellamy
synopsis: A group of camp counselors realize the cabin they're renovating was the site of a decades-old disappearance.
plot_spoiler: The missing counselor was never a victim, she staged her own disappearance and has been watching them the whole time.

title: The Understudy
cast: Priya Anand, Devon Cross, Ines Duarte
synopsis: A veteran stage actress mentors the understudy she suspects is being groomed to replace her.
plot_spoiler: She steps back from the lead role voluntarily, choosing to direct the understudy's first performance instead.

title: Deadline City
cast: Sam Kestrel, Elena Marsh, Fatima Idris
synopsis: A chaotic overnight shift at a struggling newspaper becomes a race to stop the presses on a career-ending mistake.
plot_spoiler: They stop the presses in time, but the mistake gets published anyway in an early edition nobody remembers exists.

title: Wanderlust Protocol
cast: Narrated by Jonas Weir
synopsis: A globe-spanning look at communities adapting their traditions to a rapidly changing climate.

title: Static Bloom
cast: Naledi Osei, Luca Brandt, Devon Cross
synopsis: A viral livestream trend turns deadly when a haunted filter starts showing streamers what's really in the room.
plot_spoiler: The filter reveals a presence that was always there; deleting the app doesn't stop it from spreading.

title: Crimson Tally
cast: Ines Duarte, Callum Reyes, Sam Kestrel
synopsis: An auditor at a private bank realizes every account she's asked to close belongs to a witness in the same case.
plot_spoiler: She's been the witness the whole time, her memory wiped after the first audit years earlier.

title: Lighthouse Keepers
cast: Jonas Weir, Priya Anand, Fatima Idris
synopsis: The last two keepers of an automated-out lighthouse spend their final season deciding what comes next.
plot_spoiler: One stays on as a volunteer caretaker; the other leaves to train the next generation of coastal engineers.

title: Velvet Static
cast: Voices of Devon Cross, Ines Duarte, Luca Brandt
synopsis: A retro video game character glitches out of her console and into the real world, one pixel at a time.
plot_spoiler: She chooses to stay human rather than return to the game, leaving a new character to take her place inside it.

title: The Cartographer's Daughter
cast: Naledi Osei, Théo Bellamy, Sam Kestrel
synopsis: A mapmaker's daughter discovers her father's charts describe a kingdom that only exists while someone is actively drawing it.
plot_spoiler: She finishes the final map herself, making the kingdom permanent, and takes her father's place as its cartographer.

title: Afterglow
cast: Fatima Idris, Callum Reyes, Naledi Osei
synopsis: Two strangers keep meeting at the same beach every year during the same week-long meteor shower.
plot_spoiler: After five years, they finally exchange real names and decide to meet somewhere other than the beach next time.
